description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for handling chat messages that include multimedia content such as images and PDFs, including conversion to Base64, creating message objects, and display logic.

methods.name: convertImageToBase64
methods.description: Converts a File object to a Base64 data URI string asynchronously.

methods.name: createChatMultimodalMessage
methods.description: Creates a chat message object that includes text and an image URL decoded from a File, formatted for chat display.

methods.name: createChatDisplayMessage
methods.description: Generates a MessageType object for display, appending attachment info if a file is attached.

methods.name: shouldShowChatAttachedImage
methods.description: Determines if the message should display an attached image preview based on its content.
